The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's instruction at step 10, which asked WebSurfer to "scroll through" the article. WebSurfer then scrolled only about 9% of the page per action. After four scrolls it was only 37% of the way down and never reached the bottom, where the paper is linked. The Orchestrator never asked WebSurfer to jump to the end of the page, for example with the End key. At step 22 it instead asked for a keyword search, which WebSurfer did not do. The run then ended on a content-filter error with no paper found, and the final answer, 80NSSC21K0223, was unsupported and wrong (the correct one is 80GSFC21M0002).

AGENT: Orchestrator (-> WebSurfer)
STEP: 10
